content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a Director-General position at the International Labour Organization. Tell about your experience in working life development, social dialogue, and promoting workers' rights. Describe your vision for the ILO's role in regulating global labor markets and shaping the future of work. Length about 450 words.
